title: Geologic map of the Ocean Forest quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2014, Geologic map of the Ocean Forest quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-210, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet. Unit descriptions legible; several map symbols garbled (beach sand, moved earth, freshwater marsh, Princess Anne units, Ten Mile Hill strand deposits) and left out; symbols given are inferred from placement. Three thicknesses print '|' for a digit (read as 1, flagged inferred). Pleistocene units are alloformations; subunits named as printed with parent in the note. SCGS drill holes shown only as map symbols (e.g. 26-165), logs on file at SCGS, not in this document; none recorded.
SUBSURFACE: p.1 gives elevation ranges of alloformation margins (Holocene <10 ft landward; Silver Bluff >6 ft seaward, <10 ft landward; Princess Anne >10/<18 ft; Pamlico >17/<25 ft; Ten Mile Hill >25/<35 ft), stored as contacts; vertical datum not stated in the OCR text (horizontal 1927 North American Datum; base map USGS 1973); bathymetric contours from Taylor and others (2008); SCGS drill-hole locations with log IDs on map (logs not included). No cross sections or structure-contour maps.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet). Units as before (alloformation subunits named as printed); map symbols read from the legend boxes on page-image tiles. Three thicknesses print '|' for a digit (read as 1, inferred). Margin elevations (Holocene <10 ft landward; Silver Bluff 6/10 ft; Princess Anne 10/18 ft; Pamlico 17/25 ft; Ten Mile Hill 25/35 ft) are recorded as contacts and as stated unit tops at those margins (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Whole-page image checked: no cross section or structure contours; the offshore lines are bathymetric contours (sea floor, from Taylor and others, 2008), not a geologic surface, so not recorded; SCGS drill holes (26-xxx) plotted by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS). Bodies of water and legend-only symbols not recorded.
